sentences.en: We should leave out this data. It's far from accurate.
sentences.zh: 我们最好还是把这部分数据删掉。它远不够准确。

sentences.en: Honestly, I am not the most accurate person on earth.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我不是世界上最精确的人。

sentences.en: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，一个钟表必须准确无误。

senses.zh: 准确的，精确的；（工具，方法）精密的；正确无误的；（武器、投掷）精准的
